'''Xheoch Den''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Imperial Guard]], the protectors of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], who was also a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Wielding two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Imperial forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Xheoch Den was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', which added Conquest Commanders to most of the dual-faction worlds. Den is a rare NPC enemy, and his place at [[Outpost Talarn]] on Alderaan is frequently occupied by a generic Veteran Sith Battlemaster.
